summary: Table S2 reports the registered 27-versus-6-month contrast for 817 selected male rat hypothalamus genes. Of those, 613 paired with registered effects, and 604 of 612 nonzero pairs agreed in direction. Reference coverage was 75.03%, below the 90% concordance requirement. The proposal records the scoped comparison without full verification. [Published study and supplements](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13082319/)
openIssues: The authors excluded one 27-month animal, GSM9417680, for quality concerns. The registered fit includes it.
A full tested-gene comparison requires the authors’ complete endpoint table with unrounded statistics. The Regeneron expression browser timed out, leaving any additional export there unconfirmed.
